title: iPhone 5 Can Give Qualcomm a Small Bump
text: According to a recent report from AppleInsider, citing Commercial Times as the source , Apple ( AAPL ) would dump Infineon chipsets in favor of Qualcomm ( QCOM ) chipsets for the fifth-generation Apple ( AAPL ) iPhone. The new iPhone would be based on the CDMA technology for which Qualcomm holds patents. Intel recently criticized Apple by saying that the Apple TV was a step backward, compared to the soon-to-be-released Intel-powered Google TV, according to an interview conducted by Wall Street Journal .

title: Qualcomm’s Target, Estimates Raised at Goldman Sachs (QCOM)
text: Wireless chipmaker Qualcomm, Inc. ( QCOM ) on Monday saw its price target and earnings estimates boosted by analysts at Goldman Sachs. The firm said it now expects QCOM shares to reach $52, which represents an 18% upside to the stock's Friday closing price of $44.26. The Bottom Line We had removed shares of QCOM from our "recommended" list back on Sept.25, 2008, when the stock traded at $46.54.

title: Qualcomm’s Target Boosted at Oppenheimer; Expects 14% Upside (QCOM)
text: Mobile chipmaker Qualcomm, Inc.( QCOM ) saw its price target boosted on Wednesday by analysts at Oppenheimer. The firm said it now expects shares of QCOM to reach $51, which implies a 14% upside to the stock's Tuesday closing price of $44.79. The Bottom Line We had removed shares of QCOM from our "recommended" list back on Sept.25, 2008, when the stock traded at $46.54.
